angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 422,290 km at 106.29 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.4087 +/- 0.0155 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 106.29 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.607 +/- 0.022 solar radii from David et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-284 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..302D/abstract): 422,290 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.63 +/- 0.01 solar masses from David et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-284 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..302D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4140 +/- 50 K from David et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-284 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..302D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
